query: What cross-validation schemes (leave-one-heart-out, time-block splits) best assess generalization for short noisy cardiac time series?

response.query: What cross-validation schemes (leave-one-heart-out, time-block splits) best assess generalization for short noisy cardiac time series?
response.answer: For short noisy cardiac time series, leave-one-heart-out cross-validation and time-block splits are effective for assessing generalization. Leave-one-heart-out provides robust estimates, while time-block splits account for temporal dependencies. Both methods are suitable for this context.
